facts.en: Completed a digital-image handling certificate at Fictional Irisframe Centre in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构鸢尾帧中心完成数字图像处理证书课程。

facts.en: Paid scanning assistant at Fictional Copperlight Photo Lab from 2024-02 to 2026-08 on a 3-day weekly contract.
facts.zh: 2024-02 至 2026-08 在虚构铜光照片冲印室任有薪扫描助理，合同为每周 3 天。

facts.en: Logged supplied print originals by order number and kept them in individually labeled sleeves.
facts.zh: 按订单号登记提供的纸质照片原件，并存入分别标记的保护套。

facts.en: Scanned prints using resolution and file-format settings specified on the lab’s job sheet.
facts.zh: 使用冲印室工单指定的分辨率及文件格式设置扫描照片。

facts.en: Checked exported files for missing edges, rotation and filename consistency.
facts.zh: 检查导出文件是否缺边、旋转方向是否正确，以及文件名是否一致。

facts.en: Flagged torn or heavily faded originals for the senior retoucher rather than promising restoration.
facts.zh: 将撕裂或严重褪色的原件标记给高级修图师，而非承诺修复。

facts.en: Returned originals only after the desk lead confirmed the order’s collection record.
facts.zh: 仅在柜台负责人确认订单领取记录后归还原件。

facts.en: Uses a flatbed scanner, batch-filename templates and basic image rotation and cropping controls.
facts.zh: 使用平板扫描仪、批量文件名模板及基本图像旋转和裁剪控件。

facts.en: Prepared a file-count checklist for double-sided postcard scans in 2025-05.
facts.zh: 2025-05 为双面明信片扫描准备文件数量核对表。

facts.en: A retained practice order used 48 invented postcards and produced 96 image files because both sides were scanned.
facts.zh: 一份留存的练习订单使用 48 张虚构明信片，并因扫描双面而生成 96 个图像文件。

facts.en: That practice order was not a paid customer batch; the 96 files represent sides rather than 96 distinct physical originals.
facts.zh: 该练习订单并非付费客户批次；96 个文件代表各面，而非 96 份不同实物原件。

facts.en: Attended an internal colour-profile demonstration in 2025; the senior retoucher configured the lab’s colour profiles.
facts.zh: 2025 年参加内部色彩配置文件演示；冲印室色彩配置文件由高级修图师配置。

facts.en: No independent display calibration or advanced image-restoration work is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录独立显示器校准或高级图像修复工作。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Paperfern History Circle during 2022-09 to 2023-05.
facts.zh: 2022-09 至 2023-05 在虚构纸蕨历史社做志愿者。

facts.en: For that group, entered captions supplied by contributors into a small display index; contributors retained their originals.
facts.zh: 为该团体将贡献者提供的图片说明录入小型展示索引；原件由贡献者保留。

facts.en: The volunteer group’s coordinator selected display material and handled permission questions.
facts.zh: 志愿团体协调员选择展示材料，并处理授权问题。

facts.en: Created a personal photo study of miniature cardboard houses in 2024 using the candidate’s own models and images.
facts.zh: 2024 年使用候选人自制模型及自拍图像，制作微型纸板房屋个人摄影习作。

facts.en: Showed 4 of those prints at an informal community display; there was no judging panel or recorded award.
facts.zh: 在非正式社区展示中展出其中 4 张照片；没有评审团，亦未记录奖项。

facts.en: Enjoys designing layered paper frames.
facts.zh: 爱好设计多层纸相框。

facts.en: Prepared a daily handover list identifying files awaiting retoucher review and originals awaiting collection.
facts.zh: 每日准备交接清单，列明等待修图师审核的文件及等待领取的原件。
